data.title: Invoice for "property register entry" (Grundstücksregister Online Service)
data.summary: Grundstücksregister Online Service GmbH sent an invoice (no. GRO-26-77021) to Johanna Beispielacker demanding €498.00 by 1 December 2026 for a two-year "entry" of her property Ackerstraße 26 in a private register. The letter itself admits it is only an offer and that no contract exists until payment is made, and that the register has no connection to the official German land register (Grundbuch).
data.explanation: This looks like an official invoice but the small print says it is actually an unsolicited commercial offer (Angebot): a contract only comes into being if you pay, and the "registration" is a private, non-official directory with no legal effect — it is not the real Grundbuch. This matches a known German scam pattern that preys on property owners. You are very likely not obliged to pay anything. Do not transfer money or reply unless you deliberately want this (worthless) service. If you are unsure or already paid, consider contacting consumer protection (Verbraucherzentrale) or a lawyer before taking further action.

key_facts.quote: Dieses Schreiben ist ein Angebot. Mit Ihrer Zahlung nehmen Sie es an; ein Vertrag kommt erst durch die Zahlung zustande.

items.title: Decide on the disputed €498 "property register" invoice
items.action: Do not pay unless you deliberately want this private, non-official registration; verify the sender's legitimacy first, e.g. with the Verbraucherzentrale.
items.consequence: The letter itself states no contract exists until payment is made, so if you simply ignore it, no valid contract or debt should arise.

warnings: This "invoice" is actually an unsolicited offer (Angebot): the document itself states a contract only comes into existence once you pay, so no payment is currently owed.
The "entry" is made in a private directory with no connection to the official German land register (Grundbuch), as the letter admits in small print.
This matches a known German scam pattern targeting property owners with official-looking invoices for worthless private registrations; do not pay or respond without verifying legitimacy.
